description: Monte Carlo forecast from the throughput of the 6 newest finished sprints, the sprints the hub’s Monte Carlo view and Dashboard start from: how many items in a window, or when a backlog finishes. sampleSprints is how many sprints it drew from: say that number with the forecast. Someone who picks other sprints in the Monte Carlo view sees other figures there. Answers with numbers, dates, states and work item ids only; never work item titles, descriptions, comments, tags or assigned people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}. {"error":"licence-inactive"} means the organisation’s trial has ended without a valid licence, or its licence has not been confirmed for 30 days: tell the person to open Agile Analytics in Azure DevOps and, if the answer stays the same, to ask an admin to look at Configuration → License. {"error":"no-seat"} means the plan gives Agile Analytics to assigned people only and this person has no seat: tell them to open Agile Analytics in Azure DevOps once and ask again and, if the answer stays the same, to ask an extension admin for a seat (Configuration → Access Control). {"error":"throttled"} or {"error":"timed-out"}: wait a minute and ask again.
